propositions: Ticking AC checkboxes does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint basis by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing.
Staleness error messages incorrectly name 'AC' as a basis component when AC criteria are actually part of the description key, making it impossible to identify which component actually changed.
Pre-330c attestations that hashed raw descriptions cannot match normalized recomputes when boxes are ticked, falsely reporting stale-material for unchanged tickets.
Per-component fingerprints must be signed into the manifest as additive material-part: lines so that old and new basis values cannot disagree at verification time.
Attestation refusal surfaces throughout the codebase (gates, generation, signing, CLI) must report specific changed components and remedies instead of fixed lists or generic advice.
